metadata_corrections: 2026-09-17: grpo_peak_mem_gb corrected 18.2 -> 53.4 GB. This run resumed from checkpoint-450 (job 276727), so GRPO returned after 2.3 s and torch reported the peak of that trivial segment, not of the 25.31 h that actually trained the model. grpo_seconds was already carried forward by the resume guard; peak memory was not, because the guard predates the peak-memory patch (debugging-log.md #20). 53.4 GB is the figure the four other runs on the identical recipe report. The 18.2 GB reading is kept above as grpo_peak_mem_gb_this_segment. The correction was previously applied by hand to results/grpo_results.xlsx only, so re-running analyze_results.py reverted it; fixing it here makes it survive.
